Short Description: Cumulative flow chart showing the distribution of work stages over time.
Detailed Description: Visualizes the state of all project tasks on a timeline. Helps identify bottlenecks (e.g., when a specific section widens) and evaluate work in progress (WIP) and overall flow.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: X-axis = Time. Y-axis = Cumulative number of tasks. Each colored band represents a board column/status. Calculated by adding the count of tasks currently in or past that status for each day.
Software Supporting This Feature: Jira Software, Kanbanize / Businessmap, Azure DevOps, Trello (with Power-Ups)

Short Description: Control chart measuring task cycle time and process stability.
Detailed Description: Displays individual task lead/cycle times as plot points. Includes a rolling average and standard deviation band to help assess team predictability.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: X-axis = Completion Date. Y-axis = Time (days/hours) spent moving through selected statuses. Rolling average is calculated over a chosen window (e.g., 5 tasks). Standard deviation creates the variance band.

Short Description: Chart tracking task duration from request to delivery.
Detailed Description: Measures total time from request creation to delivery (Lead Time) or from work start to completion (Cycle Time). Helps establish realistic SLA estimates for clients.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: Lead Time = Completion Date - Creation Date. Cycle Time = Completion Date - Start Date. Plots averages or distributions as a histogram/bar chart over time.
Software Supporting This Feature: Azure DevOps, Jira Software (via column data), Businessmap, Trello (Corrello Power-Up)

Short Description: Chart showing remaining work over a defined period or milestone.
Detailed Description: Primarily used in Scrum, but useful in Kanban to track progress toward a specific target (e.g., Release or Epic). Shows if work is decreasing at the expected pace.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: X-axis = Timeline (e.g., days). Y-axis = Remaining work (task count, hours, or story points). Formula: [Initial Total Work] - [Completed Work per Day]. An ideal trend line drops from start to zero at the target date.
Software Supporting This Feature: Jira Software, Azure DevOps, Trello (Agile Tools Power-Up)

Short Description: Chart tracking completed tasks alongside total scope growth.
Detailed Description: Shows accumulated completed work alongside changes in total project scope. Unlike Burndown charts, it highlights delays caused by scope creep.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: X-axis = Timeline. Y-axis = Amount of work. Displays two lines: 1) Total scope (increases if tasks are added) and 2) Cumulative completed work. Project is complete when lines meet.
Software Supporting This Feature: Jira Software, Azure DevOps, ClickUp, Monday.com

Short Description: Completion rate chart (number of completed tasks per time period).
Detailed Description: Measures team productivity by showing how many tasks/cards are completed within a given time frame (e.g., per week or per day). Helps estimate team capacity.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: Bar chart where X-axis = Time interval (e.g., weeks) and Y-axis = Count of cards moved to 'Done' during that interval.

Short Description: Flow efficiency chart measuring active work time versus wait time.
Detailed Description: Measures what percentage of a task's lifecycle consists of active work versus waiting time (queue time between stages). Uncovers process idle time.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: Flow Efficiency (%) = (Active Work Duration / Total Cycle Time) * 100. Plots this ratio per task or as an average over time.

Short Description: Chart monitoring active work volume against limits.
Detailed Description: Tracks the number of cards currently in progress relative to established WIP limits. Excessively high WIP slows down total completion rate.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: X-axis = Time. Y-axis = Number of cards in progress columns at any given time. Often features a horizontal threshold line indicating maximum allowed WIP.

Short Description: Customizable grouping charts (pie and bar charts).
Detailed Description: Aggregates board status into visual dashboards, displaying task breakdowns by assignee, label, priority, or due date.
Calculation / How the Chart is Generated: Groups filtered card counts based on selected attributes (e.g., 'Assigned To' or 'Label') and calculates percentage shares or unit counts.
